# Forge UI kit Every interactive page starts with this kit already loaded, in light and dark. Write semantic markup with these classes instead of writing your own CSS; add css only for what the kit lacks (a chart, a canvas, a custom shape). ## Design rules 1. One idea per page. A title (`fx-title`), one line of context (`fx-sub`), then the thing the person plays with. 2. Controls first, result big. Put the result in a `fx-stat` (large number) or a chart, close to the controls it changes, and update it on `input`, never behind a button. 3. Fill the width. Use `fx-grid` for side-by-side blocks; let the card height follow the content (never use `vh`). 4. Use the theme colours only: `var(--fg)`, `var(--muted)`, `var(--line)`, `var(--bg)`, `var(--surface)`, `var(--accent)`, and the chart colours `var(--c1)` to `var(--c6)`. Never hard-code white, black or grey. 5. Real data and sensible defaults: pre-fill every input so the first view is already meaningful; label units. 6. Keep the page short: at most about 40 lines of markup, 80 lines of script. Add a one-line note when numbers are illustrative. 7. A result worth acting on gets a button that calls `forge.send({label, values})` (only from a click). 8. Check the empty and extreme values (zero people, a blank field) so the page never shows NaN or Infinity. ## Layout - `.fx-stack`: vertical stack with a gap. `.fx-row`: horizontal row that wraps; add `.fx-spread` to push ends apart. - `.fx-grid`: responsive columns (min 150px); `.fx-grid.cols-2`, `.fx-grid.cols-3` fix the count. - `.fx-card`: a bordered surface for a block of content. ## Text - `.fx-title` (heading), `.fx-sub` (secondary line), `.fx-label` (small field caption), `.fx-muted` (grey text), `.fx-badge` (small pill). ## Controls - `.fx-btn` (primary), `.fx-btn.ghost` (outline). `.fx-field` wraps a caption and a control; `.fx-value` shows its live value. - `.fx-input`, `.fx-select`, `.fx-range` (a slider), `.fx-check` (a checkbox row: ``). ## Numbers and data - `.fx-stat` with `.fx-stat-value` and `.fx-stat-label`: a big number tile. - `.fx-table` (cells with class `num` align right), `.fx-bar` (progress: `
